definitions.explanation: A tarnished reputation or the stigma of having done something shameful. Refers to the stain on one's name or honor, rather than the feeling of shame itself.

examples.japanese: {汚名|おめい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{返上|へんじょう}→返上：14400_henjou⟧⟦したい→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I want to redeem my reputation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{裏切|うらぎ}り{者|もの}→裏切り者：25800_uragirimono⟧⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧{汚名|おめい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}せられた→着せる：13684_kiseru⟧。
examples.english: I was branded with the stigma of being a traitor.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{汚名|おめい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{晴|は}らし→晴らす：10538_harasu⟧、⟦{再|ふたた}び→再び：03600_futatabi⟧⟦{信頼|しんらい}→信頼：03268_shinrai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{戻|もど}した→取り戻す：04223_torimodosu⟧。
examples.english: Through years of effort, he cleared his name and regained trust.

notes:
USAGE:
{汚名|おめい} literally means "dirty name" and refers to a damaged reputation. It is almost always used with a small set of fixed collocations. The key distinction is between {汚名|おめい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{返上|へんじょう}→返上：14400_henjou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to redeem one's name through positive action) and {汚名|おめい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{晴|は}らす→晴らす：10538_harasu⟧ (to clear one's name by disproving accusations).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {汚名|おめい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{返上|へんじょう}→返上：14400_henjou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to redeem one's reputation (through achievement)
- {汚名|おめい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{晴|は}らす→晴らす：10538_harasu⟧: to clear one's name
- {汚名|おめい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}せる→着せる：13684_kiseru⟧: to brand someone with disgrace
- {汚名|おめい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{被|こうむ}る→被る：18070_koumuru⟧: to bear a stigma
- {汚名|おめい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{残|のこ}す→残す：01975_nokosu⟧: to leave a stain on one's name
